User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user account in the Amar Radio application, allowing access to personalized features and restricted radio stations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

username.description: A unique username chosen by the user for login purposes.

email.description: The user's email address, used for communication and account recovery.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account information was last updated.

favoriteStationIds.description: An array of IDs referencing radio stations that the user has marked as favorites.

lastPlayedStationId.description: The ID of the last station the user listened to.

RadioStation.title: RadioStation
RadioStation.description: Represents a radio station available for streaming.

name.description: The name of the radio station.

streamUrl.description: The URL of the audio stream.

logoUrl.description: The URL of the station's logo image.

category.description: The genre or category of the station.

artist.description: Associated artist if it is a specialized artist channel.

requiresAuthentication.description: Whether the station requires the user to be signed in.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores individual user profiles, including favorites and history.

/radioStations/{stationId}.description: Global catalog of available radio streams.
